negation-1.description: Negation is formed with the particle 'na' placed before the verb.

respect-2.description: Addressing a formal/senior listener ('sahib') shifts the verb ending toward an '-ibe' form rather than the casual '-ibu' form.

kinship-relationship-1.description: The kinship term 'dada' (elder brother) changes position and/or co-occurring verb ('aau' vs 'firli') depending on whether the sibling relationship is currently tense or reconciled. Experts disagree on the exact mechanism (word order vs. verb choice).
kinship-relationship-1.reason: expert_note:EXP01 and expert_note:EXP02 propose two different mechanisms for the same data.
